-- Extend memberships table with new fields
ALTER TABLE memberships
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS thumbnailUrl TEXT NULL AFTER description,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS features TEXT NULL AFTER thumbnailUrl,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS highlights TEXT NULL AFTER features,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sortOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 AFTER highlights,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripeProductId VARCHAR(255) NULL AFTER sortOrder,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS stripePriceId VARCHAR(255) NULL AFTER stripeProductId,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS salesPageSlug VARCHAR(200) NULL AFTER stripePriceId,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS landingBlocks LONGTEXT NULL AFTER salesPageSlug,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS seoTitle VARCHAR(255) NULL AFTER landingBlocks,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS seoDescription TEXT NULL AFTER seoTitle,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS seoImage TEXT NULL AFTER seoDescription,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AFTER createdAt;

-- Extend coupons table to support membership-specific discount codes
ALTER TABLE coupons
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS appliesToMembershipIds TEXT NULL AFTER appliesToCourseIds,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS minimumPurchaseAmount DECIMAL(12,2) NULL AFTER appliesToMembershipIds,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS firstTimeOnly BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE AFTER minimumPurchaseAmount;

-- Extend membership_plan_access to support more resource types (quiz, download, community)
-- (already has resource_type varchar so it's flexible)

-- Create membership_coupons join table for tier-specific coupon codes
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS membership_coupons (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  membershipId INT NOT NULL,
  couponId INT NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_membership_coupon (membershipId, couponId)
);

-- Create membership_bundle_items table for complex bundles
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS membership_bundle_items (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  membershipId INT NOT NULL,
  resourceType ENUM('course','quiz','download','community','webinar','product') NOT NULL,
  resourceId INT NOT NULL,
  accessType ENUM('full','preview','timed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full',
  accessDays INT NULL,
  sortOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_bundle_item (membershipId, resourceType, resourceId)
);

-- Create membership_tiers table for multi-tier plans (Bronze/Silver/Gold etc.)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS membership_tiers (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  membershipId INT NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  billingInterval ENUM('monthly','quarterly','yearly','one_time') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly',
  trialDays INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stripeProductId VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  stripePriceId VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  features TEXT NULL,
  isActive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  sortOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Create membership_tier_items table for per-tier bundle access
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS membership_tier_items (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  tierId INT NOT NULL,
  resourceType ENUM('course','quiz','download','community','webinar','product') NOT NULL,
  resourceId INT NOT NULL,
  accessType ENUM('full','preview','timed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full',
  accessDays INT NULL,
  sortOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_tier_item (tierId, resourceType, resourceId)
);

-- Create membership_subscriptions_v2 (the existing membership_subscriptions has different structure)
-- We'll use the existing membership_members table but add tier support
ALTER TABLE membership_members
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tierId INT NULL AFTER membershipId,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS couponCode VARCHAR(64) NULL AFTER tierId,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS discountAmount DECIMAL(12,2) NULL AFTER couponCode,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS renewsAt TIMESTAMP NULL AFTER expiresAt,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS orgId INT NULL AFTER id;
